question: Explain why electrostatic potential is a scalar quantity, although it is related to electric field. Give reason.

options.A: Potential is a vector because electric field is a vector
options.B: Potential has direction opposite to the electric field
options.C: Potential is scalar only at points where the electric field vanishes
options.D: Potential is scalar because $V=\frac{W}{q}$ and both work and charge are scalar quantities, even though electric field is vector
